$regime.title: Tax Regime
$regime.description:
Country code that identifies the tax regime applicable to the document.
It determines which country-specific tax rules, normalizations, and validations are applied.
It may be determined automatically via normalization of a supplier or issuer tax identity
country code.

$addons.title: Addons
$addons.description:
Keys identifying the tax addons that apply special normalization, scenarios, and
validation rules to the document.

$tags.title: Tags
$tags.description:
Keys that identify specific tax scenarios or requirements that may change the
contents of the document or imply a specific meaning. Converters may use tags to
identify situations that do not have a specific extension; for example, self-billed
or partial invoices are identified by their respective tags.

oneOf.title: Purchase Order
oneOf.description: A purchase order is a document that a buyer sends to a seller to request goods or services.

oneOf.title: Sales Order
oneOf.description: A sales order is a document that a seller sends to a buyer to confirm the sale of goods or services.

oneOf.title: Quote
oneOf.description: A quote is a document that a seller sends to a buyer to provide a price for goods or services.

series.title: Series
series.description:
Identifies groups of orders by date, business area, project, type, customer,
a combination of any, or other company specific data. If the output format does not
support the series as a separate field, it will be prepended to the code with a dash
(`-`) for separation.

code.title: Code
code.description:
Sequential identifier that uniquely identifies the order. May be left empty
initially, but is **required** to **sign** the document.

issue_time.title: Issue Time
issue_time.description:
Optional time of day when the order was issued. Some regions and formats may
require this field; otherwise it can be left nil.

op_date.title: Operation Date
op_date.description: Date when the operation defined by the order became effective.

value_date.title: Value Date
value_date.description: When the taxes of the document become accountable. Defaults to the issue date.

exchange_rates.title: Exchange Rates
exchange_rates.description: Exchange rates to be used when converting the document's monetary values into other currencies.

preceding.title: Preceding Details
preceding.description: Key information regarding previous order documents.

identities.title: Identities
identities.description: Additional codes, IDs, SKUs, or other regional or custom identifiers that may be used to identify the order.

period.title: Period
period.description: Period of time in which the order is valid.

supplier.title: Supplier
supplier.description: The entity supplying the goods or services and usually responsible for paying taxes.

customer.title: Customer
customer.description: Legal entity receiving the goods or services, may be nil in certain circumstances such as simplified invoices.

buyer.title: Buyer
buyer.description: Party who is responsible for issuing payment, if not the same as the customer.

seller.title: Seller
seller.description: Party liable to pay taxes on the transaction, if not the same as the supplier.

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: List of lines representing each of the items to be ordered.

discounts.title: Discounts
discounts.description: Discounts or allowances applied to the order totals.

charges.title: Charges
charges.description: Charges or surcharges applied to the order totals.

payment.title: Payment Details
payment.description: Information on when, how, and to whom a final invoice would be paid.

delivery.title: Delivery Details
delivery.description: Specific details on delivery of the goods to copy to the final invoice.

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: Summary of all the order totals, including taxes (calculated).

notes.title: Notes
notes.description:
Unstructured information that is relevant to the order, such as correction or additional
legal details.

complements.title: Complements
complements.description: Additional complementary objects that add relevant information to the order.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description: Additional semi-structured data that doesn't fit into the body of the order.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description:
Supporting documents that are not included in the main document. Do not use for
alternative versions of the PDF; use "links" inside the envelope headers instead.

bill.Order.description: Order documents are used for the initial part of a order-to-invoice process where the buyer requests goods or services from the seller.
